matrix_label: M5 docs-pack row and stale-example finding row primitive: pack lifecycle, verification, trust posture, example drift, version-drift context, and pin/offline/refresh/quarantine/update/remove actions

pack_finding_rows.scope_summary: The docs-pack manager renders the shared pack row so a pinned first-party pack reads as pinned-current while a mirror-served vendor pack reads as mirror-served-not-live, and the shared finding row so an API-signature drift becomes an actionable, version-anchored row rather than a vague hint

resolved.disclosure_headline: This pack is shown as [pinned] because the pack is pinned to an exact version and current — pinned_pack state on a pinned_pack pack (source: first_party_hosted, verification: signature_verified, scope: pinned_range)

This pack is shown as [mirror] because the pack is served from a mirror and is not live — mirrored_pack state on a mirrored_pack pack (source: mirrored_registry, verification: signature_verified, scope: nearby_version)
This finding is shown because the example is verified current — example_verified_current drift on a code_snippet anchor (documented: unstated, current: unstated, source: first_party_hosted)
This finding is shown because the API signature the example uses has drifted — signature_drift_actionable drift on a api_signature anchor (documented: api-1.2, current: api-1.4, source: ai_derived)

pack_finding_rows.scope_summary: The help pack panel renders the shared primitives so an unpinned API pack reads as tracking-current while an offline community pack reads as offline-only, and a config example claiming current with stale freshness is held for reverification rather than shown as verified

resolved.disclosure_headline: This pack is shown as [current] because the pack is tracking upstream and current — unpinned_tracking state on a unpinned_tracking pack (source: first_party_hosted, verification: checksum_only, scope: latest_stable)
This pack is shown as [offline] because the pack is available offline only — offline_pack state on a offline_pack pack (source: offline_import, verification: checksum_only, scope: pinned_range)

This finding is shown because the example claims current but its freshness is stale or unknown — example_current_pending_reverify drift on a config_shape anchor (documented: cfg-1, current: cfg-1, source: bundled_local)
This finding is shown because the example uses a deprecated symbol — deprecated_symbol_actionable drift on a code_snippet anchor (documented: v2, current: v3, source: third_party_hosted)

pack_finding_rows.scope_summary: The onboarding pack step renders the shared primitives so an update-available pack reads as update-overdue and a stale bundled guide pack reads as stale-needs-refresh — distinct states, never one generic warning — and a broken example link becomes an actionable finding

resolved.disclosure_headline: This pack is shown as [update] because an update to the pack is available — update_available state on a update_available pack (source: first_party_hosted, verification: signature_verified, scope: latest_stable)
This pack is shown as [stale] because the pack is stale and needs a refresh — pinned_pack state on a pinned_pack pack (source: bundled_local, verification: signature_verified, scope: pinned_range)
This finding is shown because the example links to a broken target — broken_reference_actionable drift on a link_target anchor (documented: unstated, current: unstated, source: mirrored_registry)

pack_finding_rows.scope_summary: The AI pack-context panel renders the shared primitives so a quarantined community pack reads as quarantined-untrusted and is never cited as trusted, and a version-mismatched CLI example becomes an actionable finding with the documented and current versions on the row

resolved.disclosure_headline: This pack is shown as [quarantined] because the pack is quarantined pending review and not trusted — quarantined_pack state on a quarantined_pack pack (source: third_party_hosted, verification: unverified, scope: unversioned)

This finding is shown because the example is bound to a mismatched version — version_mismatch_actionable drift on a shell_command anchor (documented: cli-1.0, current: cli-2.0, source: offline_import)
This finding is shown because the example is unverified and needs a check — unverified_needs_check drift on a config_shape anchor (documented: unstated, current: unstated, source: first_party_hosted)

pack_finding_rows.scope_summary: The support pack evidence view renders the shared primitives so a pinned pack that failed verification reads as verification-unverified — never trusted — and every finding keeps its concrete anchor and source descriptors so identity survives the support/AI evidence path

resolved.disclosure_headline: This pack is shown as [unverified] because the pack failed verification and is not trusted — pinned_pack state on a pinned_pack pack (source: first_party_hosted, verification: verification_failed, scope: exact_version_match)
This finding is shown because the example uses a deprecated symbol — deprecated_symbol_actionable drift on a code_snippet anchor (documented: retry-0.9, current: retry-1.0, source: mirrored_registry)
